title: City of Melbourne building permits: permits, occupancy permits and certificates of final inspection whose description of works names a change of use
provider: City of Melbourne, Open Data Platform (Opendatasoft Explore API v2.1): dataset building-permits
credit: Building permits: City of Melbourne, CC BY 4.0
licence: CC BY 4.0 (stated in the dataset's metadata, license CC BY, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode; checked 2026-11-05)
format: CSV separated by semicolons, with a byte-order mark; one row a permit or certificate. Fields: council_ref (the City's reference, BP-<year>-<n>, shared by the documents of one matter); permit_number; issue_date; address (text, e.g. "25-31 Sutherland Street, MELBOURNE VIC 3000" or "Shop 2, 123 Collins Street, MELBOURNE VIC 3000": no identifier of the property and no coordinates); desc_of_works (free text); estimated_cost_of_works (A$); rbs_number (the building surveyor's registration); commence_by_date; completed_by_date; permit_certificate_type (Building Permit, Occupancy Permit, Certificate of Final Inspection, ...). The request keeps the rows whose desc_of_works contains "change of use" (the API's like, case-insensitive).
coverage: The municipality, issue dates 1992-09-09 to 2026-12-22 (sic: a date in the future in the City's data): 4,129 rows of 184,968 (checked 2026-11-05; the dataset modified 2026-11-04).

change-of-use.description: Every permit or certificate naming a change of use (about 0.6 MB; fetch again with --refresh as the City adds permits)
